keyPoints: Do char, do samikaran — hal wo (x, y) hai jo dono ko santusht kare: x + y = 10, x - y = 4 me (7, 3).
Aalekhiy vidhi: dono rekhaon ke aalekh banao — kaat bindu hi hal hai; samantar rekhaen = koi hal nahi.
Pratisthapan (substitution): ek samikaran se x ya y nikalo, doosre me rakho — phir ek char wala samikaran hal karo.
Vilopan (elimination): guna karke ek char ke gunank barabar karo, phir jod-ghata se vilopt karo — lakshya ek char ko poori tarah khatm karna hai.
a1/a2, b1/b2, c1/c2 ki tulna se pehle hi batao: teeno bhinna to advitiya hal; sab barabar to anant hal; pehle do barabar teesra nahi to koi hal nahi.
Umar, sankhya, bhinn, paisa-vasooli ke sawal isi jod se bante hain.
Aam galti: vilopan me guna karte samay sirf ek pad me guna karna — poore samikaran ke har pad me guna karo.
subject: Maths
title: Do Rekhik Samikaranon ka Jod
